author: asukhobo
title: GPU unit tests fail to extract OpenVINO package - tbb12.dll locked (Access denied) on Windows self-hosted runner
signature: remove item cannot remove item access to the path is denied unauthorizedaccessexception|Infrastructure

failed_jobs.name: GPU unit tests
failed_jobs.symptom: Extract OpenVINO packages step fails: Remove-Item cannot delete tbb12.dll, Access to the path is denied

key_errors: Remove-Item : Cannot remove item C:\actions-runner\_work\openvino\openvino\install\runtime\3rdparty\tbb\bin\tbb12.dll: Access to the path 'C:\actions-runner\_work\openvino\openvino\install\runtime\3rdparty\tbb\bin\tbb12.dll' is denied.
root_cause: Expand-Archive -Force attempts to overwrite the previously extracted openvino_package.zip on the Windows self-hosted runner's workspace, but tbb12.dll from the prior extraction is still memory-mapped/locked by a lingering process (e.g. an antivirus scan or a not-yet-terminated test/runner process from a previous job on the same machine), so Remove-Item fails with UnauthorizedAccessException before the new archive can be written. This is a recurring Windows self-hosted runner hygiene issue, not a code defect in the PR (whose only change is an NPU-specific cmake download script unrelated to this job).
reproduction_steps: N/A - requires the exact Windows self-hosted runner state (file lock on tbb12.dll from a prior job). Not reproducible from a clean local environment.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed 'GPU unit tests' job (transient runner-state issue); it typically succeeds on retry once the lock is released.

Investigate why tbb12.dll remains locked after the previous job on this runner finishes (e.g. check for dangling test processes, antivirus real-time scanning, or an open handle from the test executable) and ensure full process cleanup/workspace reset between jobs.
Consider adding a short retry/wait loop around Expand-Archive or explicit process cleanup step before 'Extract OpenVINO packages' on Windows self-hosted runners.
prevention_strategies: Add automatic retry with backoff for extraction steps on Windows self-hosted runners, and/or a pre-step that forcibly terminates lingering processes holding handles under the install directory before Expand-Archive runs. Track runner health so recurring lock issues can be flagged for runner-pool maintenance.
historical_context: This exact signature (95bb23aa2ed8a84d) has now recurred 8 times since 2026-11-09T19:06:46Z, most recently 4 times within the last 12 hours, across unrelated PRs (#37406, #39577, #39668, #39034, #39444, #39617). A rerun-pattern PR (#39664) proposing the search string 'RemoveFileSystemItemUnAuthorizedAccess,Microsoft.PowerShell.Commands.RemoveItemCommand' for the automated workflow rerunner is already open and pending maintainer review.
